question: Which of the following states of India is the first to receive rainfall from the South West Monsoon?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kerala** is the first state in India to receive rainfall from the **South West Monsoon**.
 
• The onset of the South West Monsoon typically occurs in Kerala **around the beginning of June**.
 
• This marks the start of the monsoon season in India, which gradually progresses to other parts of the country.
 
• The South West Monsoon is crucial for the Indian subcontinent, providing the majority of the annual rainfall and supporting agriculture.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The South West Monsoon winds are driven by the **differential heating of land and sea**, along with the **Coriolis effect**.
 
• The monsoon is divided into two branches:** the Arabian Sea branch and the Bay of Bengal branch**, both of which contribute to the rainfall in various regions of India.
 
• The arrival and strength of the monsoon are monitored by the India Meteorological Department (IMD).
 
• Monsoon rains are vital for replenishing water resources, supporting agriculture, and maintaining ecological balance in the region.
 
• Variability in monsoon patterns can have significant impacts on agriculture, water supply, and overall economic activity in India.
